map.极惯性矩（J = π·d⁴ / 32） 使用指南: Polar Moment of Inertia (J = π·d⁴ / 32) User Guide
map.圆截面极惯性矩计算器：输入圆截面直径 d，按 J = πd⁴/32 求抗扭几何参: Polar moment of inertia calculator for a solid circular section: enter the diameter d and compute the torsional geometric property J = πd⁴/32, used in circular shaft torsion calculations.
map.圆截面抗扭的几何参数。: The geometric property of a circular section under torsion.
map.圆轴扭转分析输入几何量（同极惯性矩）。: Geometric input for circular shaft torsion analysis (the polar moment of inertia).
map.多段阶梯轴扭转刚度计算。: Torsional stiffness calculation for stepped shafts.
map.与剪应力、扭转角公式联动。: Works together with the shear stress and angle-of-twist formulas.
map.：d=0.1 m：J=πd⁴/32=9.82×10⁻⁶ m⁴。: With d = 0.1 m, J = πd⁴/32 = 9.82×10⁻⁶ m⁴.
map.：同外径空心（内径 0.05）J 略小，但减重显著，比强度更优。: A hollow shaft of the same outer diameter (bore 0.05) has a slightly smaller J but saves considerable weight and offers a better strength-to-weight ratio.
map.非圆截面扭转用圣维南扭转常数，不能用此圆截面公式。: Torsion of non-circular sections uses the Saint-Venant torsion constant, so this circular-section formula does not apply.
